ResearchProjectDef.label: Automated extraction
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build automated machines that extract and refine raw materials: the automated smelter, drill platform, heavy-duty saw and biofuel refinery.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Automated food production
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build automated machines that grow, catch and process food, such as the automated farmer and automated mincer.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Automated crafting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build automated machines that craft finished goods, such as the automated loom and automated ammunition press. They can only output goods of normal quality.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Factory processing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build conveyor-fed factories that process goods in bulk: the conveyor oven, conveyor crematorium, automated distillery, drug granulator and neutroamine synthesizer.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Factory manufacturing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build conveyor-fed factories for precision manufacturing: the automated alloy forge, automated assembler and automated machining bay. The machining bay can only output goods of normal quality.
